description: This file defines React components for a channel header plugin in Mattermost, including dropdown menus, toggle buttons, and handling of app bindings and actions within the channel header.

classes.name: CustomMenu
classes.description: A React component for rendering a custom dropdown menu with root close handling.

classes.name: CustomToggle
classes.description: A React component for rendering a custom toggle button for the dropdown.

classes.name: ChannelHeaderPlug
classes.description: Main React component managing channel header plugin buttons, dropdowns, and app bindings.

methods.name: handleRootClose
methods.description: Handles closing the custom menu when clicking outside.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the CustomMenu component with children.

methods.name: handleClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the CustomToggle button.

methods.name: createComponentButton
methods.description: Creates a button for a plugin component with tooltip and action handling.

methods.name: onBindingClick
methods.description: Handles clicking on an app binding, executing associated actions and handling responses.

methods.name: createAppBindingButton
methods.description: Creates a button for an app binding with icon and label.

methods.name: createDropdown
methods.description: Creates a dropdown menu with plugin components and app bindings.

methods.name: fireAction
methods.description: Executes a given action with current channel and member context.

methods.name: fireActionAndClose
methods.description: Executes an action and then closes the dropdown.
